cards.card_text: Then the LORD looks ahead to a day when Israel is in its own land and an adversary attacks.
cards.verse_text: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.
cards.snippet: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will…

cards.verse_text: He must not go down with us into battle only to become our adversary during the war.
cards.snippet: …must not go down with us into battle only to become our adversary during the war.

cards.verse_text: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or crisis.
cards.snippet: …God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or crisis.

cards.card_text: It's the LORD who raised up Hadad the Edomite as an adversary against Solomon.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
cards.snippet: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.

cards.card_text: That's like quitting the best job you ever had, and when the boss asks what's wrong, you just say, 'Nothing.' And Hadad isn't the only one, because God raises up another adversary against Solomon.
cards.verse_text: But Pharaoh asked him, “What have you lacked here with me that you suddenly want to go back to your own country?” “Nothing,” Hadad replied, “but please let me go.” And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah,
cards.snippet: …“but please let me go.” And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer…

cards.card_text: The new adversary is Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his ___, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
cards.verse_text: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah,
cards.snippet: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer…

cards.card_text: Who does Queen Esther call the adversary and enemy?
cards.verse_text: Esther replied, “The adversary and enemy is this wicked man—Haman!” And Haman stood in terror before the king and queen.
cards.snippet: Esther replied, “The adversary and enemy is this wicked man—Haman!” And Haman stood in terror before…

cards.card_text: They forgot the day He redeemed them from the adversary.
cards.verse_text: They did not remember His power—the day He redeemed them from the adversary,
cards.snippet: They did not remember His power—the day He redeemed them from the adversary,

cards.card_text: He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
cards.verse_text: He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
cards.snippet: …His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.

cards.card_text: The adversary seizes all her treasures.
cards.verse_text: The adversary has seized all her treasures.
cards.snippet: The adversary has seized all her treasures.

cards.card_text: Jesus says that when you're on the way to court with an adversary, it's best to wait and let the judge settle it.
cards.verse_text: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court.
cards.snippet: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court.

cards.card_text: Reconcile quickly, Jesus says, or your adversary may hand you to the judge, the judge to the officer, and into prison you may go.
cards.verse_text: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court.
cards.snippet: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus paints a picture: you and your adversary, on your way to the magistrate together.
cards.verse_text: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate.
cards.snippet: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate.

cards.card_text: On the way to the magistrate, Jesus says to make every effort to ___ with your adversary, or it might not end well.
cards.verse_text: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate.
cards.snippet: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate.

cards.card_text: Otherwise, your adversary may drag you off to the judge, the judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.
cards.verse_text: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate.
cards.snippet: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate.

cards.card_text: In that town there's a widow, and she comes to this judge: 'Give me justice against my adversary.' Of all the people in town, she's asking the one man who doesn't care.
cards.verse_text: And there was a widow in that town who kept appealing to him, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’
cards.snippet: …that town who kept appealing to him, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’

cards.card_text: Paul says that denies the adversary occasion for slander, so the adversary comes looking for dirt and leaves with EMPTY hands.
cards.verse_text: So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
cards.snippet: …younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.

cards.card_text: Then Peter says to be sober-minded and alert, and he names their adversary: the devil, who prowls around like a roaring lion.
cards.verse_text: Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
cards.snippet: Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
